Question ID: ENV_U05_L05_GP_Q01
MLA Standard: MLA.ENV.PCH.05

Guided practice item 1.
Lesson focus: Technology and Environmental Quality
Stimulus: Technology impact stimulus

A student reviews the required environmental evidence and must explain the first clear pattern. Which answer uses the lesson evidence most accurately?

generalfeedback.text: Teachable feedback: First, Identify the pollutant, climate factor, technology, or waste pathway. Then use the required stimulus (Technology impact stimulus) to connect the visible evidence to climate, pollution, waste, technology, and environmental quality evidence. Correct reasoning stays inside MLA.ENV.PCH.05 and avoids the common mistake: treating one event, pollutant, or technology as proof of an entire environmental trend.
